name: questions.risks_constraints.baseline
description: Baseline questions about known risks, open dependencies, and constraints flagged by the client.

questions.text: What are the top three risks the sponsor is most worried about today?
questions.rationale: Sponsor-stated risks are a strong signal for where to concentrate assessment depth.

questions.text: Are there hard dependencies on other teams, vendors, or regulatory milestones?
questions.rationale: External dependencies are a common reason good plans slip — naming them unblocks contingency planning.

questions.text: What organisational or political constraints should we be aware of?
questions.rationale: Hidden org-level constraints often outrank technical ones for actual feasibility.

questions.text: Any prior assessments or audit findings still outstanding?
questions.rationale: Prior findings are cheap evidence — often flag 60%+ of what we'd otherwise re-discover.
